desc: Implement input parsing and early checks for equality, K >= max length, and length difference > K.
Implement banded edit-distance DP over diagonals with rolling arrays, tight band bounds, boundary handling, and early row cutoff.
Validate the solution on the public samples and key edge cases.
Confirm the complexity is O(min(len(S), len(T)) * K) time and O(K) memory, suitable for K <= 20 and length <= 500000.
